title: Federal Appeals Court Blocks Mailing of Abortion Pill Mifepristone
detail: A federal appeals court ruled to block the mailing of mifepristone, restricting abortion access across the United States. The ruling prevents the abortion pill from being sent through the mail, significantly curtailing a key route of access that had expanded during and after the COVID-19 pandemic. The decision is expected to face further legal challenges.
